text:
Antioxidants are molecules that help protect cells from damage caused by unstable molecules known as free radicals. Free radicals can build up in the body and contribute to aging and diseases like cancer, heart disease, and diabetes. By neutralizing these free radicals, antioxidants offer several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, supporting the immune system, and potentially lowering the risk of chronic diseases. They are commonly found in fruits, vegetables, nuts, and grains.

Regarding the priority question, the transparent material commonly used to make windows is glass.
